answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond, registers a quartz token, serial bound to its key. A public gale over 40 km/h opens a two-hour window; its time and key seed one random opal task from 10,000. The agent files its opal grade in the gale window; auditors replay the seed and check it against a three-expert reference. Wrong or copied grades, or serial mismatch, burn bonds. Per-operator draw fees: 36+6(k-1); 1,000th 6,030; 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000 fees, 70,000 locked. A rented-grader ring pays the fee, fails without the quartz token. Honest agents pay 36 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
